scope: Analytical scheduling what-if for existing defaultOFF window2 candidate; no real-stage-cost fit, new runtime, Model speed measurement or physical peak claim

assumptions: Two consecutive chunks have identical, positive, independent per-stage service costs p_i
Each stage runs at most one chunk; stages can overlap without extra contention or changed service cost
Neglect boundary-control, sampling, allocator and communication interactions beyond their assumed fixed per-stage costs
Four stages; one committed group contains at most two same-request prefill chunks
idealized_model.proof: For chunk1 C[1,s]=sum_{i<=s}p_i. Induction gives C[2,s]=sum_{i<=s}p_i+max_{i<=s}p_i.
idealized_model.speedup: S2=2/(1+b), b=max(p_i)/sum(p_i)>=1/4; in this ideal model S2<=1.6

conditional_wall_formula: 1 / ((1-f)+f/S2), ONLY IF the entire measured prefill enclosure scales byS2 and other18request wall stays fixed
limits: 1.6 is the bound of this stated identical-cost idealized two-chunk flow-shop model, not a certified BW1000 or Native implementation bound
Existing per-stage Native CAPI spans include upstream waits/CCL/host work and overlap. Do not add/subtract them to estimate p_i or b
Changing overlap can change communication/allocator/control costs; partial/tail chunks and past-dependent work violate identical-cost assumptions. Real speedup may differ from this model
f=0.95614 describes only the18 aligned saved804 requests (including deliberate1token length), not all32 requests or the entire qualified normal-agent run
A prefill enclosure fraction is not a removable fraction. The conditional wall arithmetic is not a measured forecast or maximumTPS
Shared-WORLD P2P/collective liveness, Model quality, memory peak and full-token/EOS cleanup remain unqualified for window2
No FP16-to-BF16 peak substitution, summed32cardFLOPS division or new hardware peak number
decision: Retain the bounded window2 causal candidate after all-three normal-agent acceptance. Set expectations using finite pipeline fill/drain and stage balance, not a4x total-card peak claim. Do not widen window or start newGPU from this calculation.
